headline: Colonials Gain in Weathered Expanse; Marban Hollow Swings Back; Nevish Line Even
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has turned the Colonial way since the last edition: its works now stand at five Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, where three hours ago the count read four Colonial, three Warden and two unclaimed. Sixty actions were logged there in the past day, six of them within two hours and the latest at 08:46, at a cost of 6,994 Colonial and 7,890 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow has swung back the other way, to four Colonial works, two Warden and two unclaimed, from six Colonial and one Warden; Checkpoint Bua accounts for twenty-six of the thirty-seven actions there. The Nevish Line is now level at four works apiece, Princefal and Blackcoat Way the busiest, though only one action fell in the last two hours. Kuura Strand reads four Colonial to two Warden after twenty-nine actions in the day, Faden Point the centre of it. Linn Mercy's bloodletting has eased, down to eight Colonial and eighteen Warden in the last hour from far heavier tallies, its works nine Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle remain costly but nearly still.
